<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Oho! Look at that, <$cdef(27)>! I spy a
<$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center!
<$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,4)>But...as I suppose I should have expected, it’s gone to ruin.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Olha para isto. <$cdef(27)>Estou a ver.
<$cdef(27)>Centro Pokémon!
<$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,4)>Mas... como eu acho que eu deveria ter esperado, ele foi para a ruína.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Hm? Look, there’s a Pokémon near it!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)>Right, then! First, let’s try talking to that Pokémon.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Hm? Olhe, há um Pokémon perto dele!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)>Certo, então! Primeiro, vamos tentar falar com aquele Pokémon.
